description: Prove that the common core is a useful independent package by running a workforce calculation and a genomics workflow through installed Python bindings and the same Rust implementation.
external_dependencies: edithatogo/microcosting_healthworkforce: rule/source ownership and import namespace migration remain provider-owned.
edithatogo/microcosting_genomics: resource recipes and workbook/assay evidence remain provider-owned.
completion_evidence: Both domain consumers invoke the same Rust numerical implementation rather than copying arithmetic into Python.
Native and independently installed Python results match the same exact fixtures, including a nonterminating exposure and sub-cent allocation.
One genomic workflow consumes one dated workforce quotation release without duplicating its loaded components.
Historical workbook comparisons identify expected differences and repairs separately from mechanical extraction.
Errors, missing values, ownership/lifetimes and exact-number transport are exercised through the installed wheel.
Declared Python support matches tested dependencies; no provider pin is loosened merely to make packaging resolve.
